957-2707-8267.easyPrerequisites: Cybernetic Specialist doesn't have summoning sickness.
957-2707-8267.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Cybernetic Specialist by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to put Time Stretch on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Stretch from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Move to your second extra turn and repeat.

628-7191-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Bristlebane Battler.
When Bristlebane Battler dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Repeat.

3899-7940--5.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Support Mission triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat

223-4285.manaNeeded: {R}{R} plus the cost of the additional sorcery
223-4285.notablePrerequisites: You have an additional castable sorcery.
223-4285.description:
Cast any sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Increasing Vengeance by paying its mana cost.
Kalamax's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first ability, creating a copy of Increasing Vengeance and choosing to copy the original Increasing Vengeance.
Resolve the second ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kalamax.
Resolve the Increasing Vengeance copy, creating a copy of Increasing Vengeance.
Kalamax's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 6 any number of times.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2122-7737-7824.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw two cards.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton
Repeat.

5035-5104-6797.description:
Cast Plague of Vermin by paying {6}{B} and choosing to pay any amount of life, creating that many 1/1 Rat creature tokens.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a Rat.
When the Rat dies, Nadier's Nightblade triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 2 as able.
5035-5104-6797.notes: It's recommended to pay as much life as possible to maximize the amount of lifeloss. If an opponent happens to pay life during casting Plague of Vermin, those additional Rats can also be sacrificed.

1619-4605-5542-6148-6797.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5542-6148-6797.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Seasoned Dungeoneer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Seasoned Dungeoneer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Seasoned Dungeoneer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Seasoned Dungeoneer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Seasoned Dungeoneer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Seasoned Dungeoneer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Seasoned Dungeoneer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Seasoned Dungeoneer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5542-6148-6797.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1661-5078-7692.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

1137-2092-2757-5140.description:
Activate a basic Swamp by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {B} due to Agatha, returning Rith's Attendant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Rith's Attendant, untapping the basic Swamp.
Activate Rith's Attendant by paying {1} and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3129-3899-4742.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

5147-6249-7256--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
5147-6249-7256--5.description:
Cast Warhost's Frenzy with kicker by paying {2}{B}{R}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Warhost's Frenzy trigger.
Resolve the Warhost's Frenzy trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1400-4619-6798.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1400-4619-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Teysa triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token that is black due to Darkest Hour.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2459-5220-5256-6900.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Rograkh
When Rograkh dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Rograkh from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Cast Rograkh from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1251-4251-6911.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1251-4251-6911.description:
Declare Godo as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing you to untap it and all Samurai you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Godo, triggering Impostor Syndrome, creating a token copy of Godo that isn't legendary.
When the Godo token enters, it triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment and put it onto the battlefield.
During your next combat phase, declare Godo and the Godo token as attackers.
The Godo token triggers, causing you to untap it and all Samurai you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

2173-2511-5220-6539.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Willow Geist.
When Willow Geist dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Willow Geist from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Willow Geist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Cast Willow Geist from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

1495-2313-4613-6843.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Conclave Mentor.
Activate Anti-Venom using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

527-2034-2178-6730.notablePrerequisites: There are at least X counters on artifacts, creatures and/or enchantments you control, where X is 1 plus the number of times you've cast Sin from the command zone this game.
527-2034-2178-6730.description:
Cast Sin either from your hand or command zone by paying {5}{G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
As Sin enters, remove all counters from all artifacts, enchantments and creatures you control, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{U} plus an additional {X} equal to Sin's power minus 3.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sin, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to return Sin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sin dies, it and Selvala trigger.
Resolve the Sin trigger, putting its counters on Selvala.
Resolve the Selvala trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

3705-4050-5997-6705.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 1/1 Frog and a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Squee, the Frog and the Alien Warrior, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

851-3951-5703-5929.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
851-3951-5703-5929.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more charge counters on it

198-4067-5672.easyPrerequisites: You have a nonland card in hand.
198-4067-5672.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Activate Tasigur by paying {2}{G/U}{G/U}, causing you to mill two cards and return a nonland card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

586-2034-5258-5618.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Priest of Gix, adding {C}{C}.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {3}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

575-2034-2690.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Rattleclaw Mystic, adding {C}{C}.
When Rattleclaw Mystic dies, Yedora triggers, returning Rattleclaw Mystic from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Rattleclaw Mystic's morph ability by paying {2}, turning it face up.
Rattleclaw Mystic triggers, adding {G}{U}{R}.
Repeat.

1912-3493-4949.notablePrerequisites: Patrol Signaler does not have summoning sickness.
1912-3493-4949.description:
Activate Patrol Signaler by tapping it, adding {W} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Patrol Signaler by paying {W} and untapping it, creating a 1/1 Kithkin Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

1887-2290-3129-4158-4929.notablePrerequisites:
Cryptic Trilobite and Spike Feeder have at least one +1/+1 counter.
Your life total is at least four.
1887-2290-3129-4158-4929.description:
Activate Staff of Compleation's third ability by tapping it and paying three life, causing you to put four +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite and Spike Feeder.
Activate Spike Feeder's second ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to gain four life.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding six {C} that can only be spent to activate abilitieis.
Activate Staff of Compleation's last ability by paying {5}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana and life, you may activate Staff of Compleation's other abilities.

2269-4050-4840-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Myr Battlesphere, adding {G}.
Myr Battlesphere dies, triggering Mortuary, putting Myr Battlesphere on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Call of the Wild by paying {2}{G}{G}, revealing Myr Battlesphere from the top of your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Myr tokens, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Call of the Wild's ability to put all creature cards from your library onto the battlefield.

430-2743-3433.notablePrerequisites: You have not created any tokens this turn.
430-2743-3433.description:
Cast Hornet Queen by paying {4}{G}{G}{G}.
Hornet Queen enters the battlefield, creating four token copies of Biovisionary due to Esix.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.
